Supergoop!

The Sunscreening

For Supergoop at Ulta FLC, Pop Up Mob developed a Sunscreening theme as a movie theater-inspired world that made sun care feel culturally engaging, using nostalgia and spectacle to spotlight Glow Screen in a crowded trade show setting.

BeautyApril 2025San Antonio, TexasUlta FLC100% Experiential
The Story
San Antonio, TX

Pop Up Mob transformed the Supergoop booth at Ulta FLC into a movie-theater-inspired brand world that positioned the Glow Screen collection as the stars of the show. Inside the space, guests moved through the experience like moviegoers: checking in at a ticket counter, scratching off admit one cards for the chance to win merch and gratis, and redeeming prizes at a reimagined concession stand. Oversized vintage-style movie posters framed the collection at the entrance, while a theater seating moment and jumbo branded screen created an immersive focal point for content, education, and social capture. Sampling was fully integrated into the world, with products packaged in custom Supergoop movie candy boxes that made trial feel thematic.
